tuning_key.text: Freedom, happiness, beauty, and love / Phantoms, of what could be to come
tuning_key.attribution: Chords of Truth — Lucid Principles Canon (CC BY 4.0)

context_block: The horizon shimmers with phantoms of what could be to come—freedom, happiness, beauty, and love dancing just out of reach yet warming your chest completely. You do not need to capture these glimmers to join their dance; the chase itself is the joy, irregular and bright, manifesting possibility already alive within you. Let the reaching be the destination.

practice.title: Widen the Gaze
practice.instruction: Allow your peripheral vision to expand softly, letting the world blur at the edges while a distant glimmer manifests in the center of your chest instead of your eyes.

practice.title: The Ungrasping Reach
practice.instruction: Gently extend your fingers toward something just out of reach—a building, a tree, a cloud—feeling the warmth of wanting ignite in your palms without closing your fist.

practice.title: Join the Dance
practice.instruction: Whisper the words "phantoms of what could be to come" and let the vibration dissolve into your sternum, the echo becoming real as warmth, irregular, bright, and completely enough.
